<style id="kqf-css">
/* Kids Party House quote form (kqf) — collapsed until the visitor starts */
.qform form.kqf{display:block}
.kqf .kqf-s1{display:grid;gap:13px}
.kqf .kqf-loc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:104px minmax(0,1fr);gap:9px}
.kqf .kqf-combo{position:relative;min-width:0}
.kqf .kqf-list{position:absolute;z-index:40;left:0;right:0;top:calc(100% + 6px);margin:0;padding:6px;list-style:none;background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--lilac,#D6C6E6);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg,0 22px 55px rgba(62,65,69,.12));max-height:280px;overflow-y:auto}
.kqf .kqf-list[hidden]{display:none}
.kqf .kqf-list li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:14.4px;line-height:1.35;color:var(--charcoal,#3E4145);cursor:pointer}
.kqf .kqf-list li small{flex:0 0 auto;font-size:12.2px;color:var(--muted,#6B7076)}
.kqf .kqf-list li[aria-selected=true],.kqf .kqf-list li:hover{background:#F4F0FA;color:var(--lilac-t,#6C5691)}
.kqf .kqf-list li.kqf-none{cursor:default;background:#fff;color:var(--muted,#6B7076)}
.kqf .kqf-list b{font-weight:700}
.kqf input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--peach-t,#B0522F)}
.kqf .kqf-help{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:12.2px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--muted,#6B7076)}
.kqf .kqf-start{width:100%;margin-top:4px}
.hero-split:has(.kqf),.hero-grid:has(.kqf){align-items:start}
/* collapsible part */
.kqf .kqf-more{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.kqf .kqf-more-in{min-height:0;overflow:hidden;visibility:hidden;padding:0 4px;margin:0 -4px;transition:visibility 0s linear .5s}
.kqf:focus-within .kqf-more,.kqf.kqf-open .kqf-more,
.kqf:has(.kqf-s1 input:not(:placeholder-shown)) .kqf-more,
.kqf:has(.kqf-s1 textarea:not(:placeholder-shown)) .kqf-more{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.kqf:focus-within .kqf-more-in,.kqf.kqf-open .kqf-more-in,
.kqf:has(.kqf-s1 input:not(:placeholder-shown)) .kqf-more-in,
.kqf:has(.kqf-s1 textarea:not(:placeholder-shown)) .kqf-more-in{visibility:visible;transition-delay:0s}
.kqf:focus-within .kqf-start,.kqf.kqf-open .kqf-start,
.kqf:has(.kqf-s1 input:not(:placeholder-shown)) .kqf-start,
.kqf:has(.kqf-s1 textarea:not(:placeholder-shown)) .kqf-start{display:none}
.kqf .kqf-steps{display:grid;gap:13px;padding-top:6px}
.kqf .kqf-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:12px 0 0;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#E7E8EA);font-family:Poppins,Inter,sans-serif;font-size:15.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;color:var(--charcoal,#3E4145)}
.kqf .kqf-h{align-items:baseline;gap:12px;font-size:17px}
.kqf .kqf-h span{font:600 11.5px/1 Poppins,Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--lilac-t,#6C5691)}
.kqf .kqf-h1{margin-top:2px}
.kqf .kqf-req-note{margin:0 0 2px;font-size:12.8px;color:var(--muted,#6B7076)}
/* option chips */
.kqf fieldset{margin:0;padding:0;border:0;min-width:0}
.kqf legend{display:block;padding:0;margin:0 0 7px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted,#6B7076)}
.kqf .kqf-opts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}
.kqf .kqf-opt{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:0;padding:8px 13px;border:1.5px solid var(--line,#E7E8EA);border-radius:999px;background:#FCFBFA;font-size:13.8px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.3;color:var(--charcoal,#3E4145);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,background .15s}
.kqf .kqf-opt:hover{border-color:var(--lilac,#D6C6E6)}
.qform .kqf .kqf-opt input{width:15px;height:15px;min-width:15px;margin:0;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:none;box-shadow:none;-webkit-appearance:auto;appearance:auto;accent-color:var(--lilac-t,#6C5691);cursor:pointer}
.kqf .kqf-opt:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--lilac-t,#6C5691);background:#F4F0FA;color:var(--lilac-t,#6C5691)}
.kqf .kqf-opt:has(input:focus-visible){box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(214,198,230,.6)}
/* file */
.kqf .kqf-drop{padding:16px;border:1.5px dashed var(--lilac,#D6C6E6);border-radius:16px;background:#FBF9FD;text-align:center}
.qform .kqf .kqf-drop input[type=file]{width:100%;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:0;background:none;box-shadow:none;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--muted,#6B7076)}
.kqf .kqf-drop input[type=file]::file-selector-button{margin-right:10px;padding:9px 16px;border:1.5px solid var(--line,#E7E8EA);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;font:600 13px/1 Poppins,Inter,sans-serif;color:var(--charcoal,#3E4145);cursor:pointer}
.kqf .kqf-consent{margin:4px 0 0;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;background:#F6F3FB;font-size:12.4px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted,#6B7076)}
.kqf .kqf-submit{width:100%}
@media(max-width:600px){.kqf .frow fieldset{min-width:0}.kqf .kqf-loc{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.kqf .kqf-more,.kqf .kqf-more-in{transition:none}}
.kqf .req{color:#D61F2C;font-size:2em;font-weight:700;line-height:0;vertical-align:-.3em;margin-left:1px}
.kqf .kqf-optional{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted,#6B7076);opacity:.85}
.kqf .kqf-upsell{margin:-2px 0 2px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--charcoal,#3E4145)}
.kqf .kqf-included{border-color:var(--lilac-t,#6C5691);background:#F4F0FA;color:var(--lilac-t,#6C5691);cursor:default}
.kqf .kqf-included em{font-style:normal;opacity:.75}
.qform .kqf .kqf-included input{pointer-events:none}
.kqf .kqf-inc-row{margin-bottom:4px}
</style>

<script>window.MEM_SITE = "kidspartyhouse";</script>
<script>
/* My Event Match funnel tracker — include on every site (MEM + the six category sites) just before </body>.
   Reads UTMs and click IDs, keeps first-touch on the visitor and last-touch on the session, sends page/step events
   to the My Event Match tracking endpoint. No third-party cookies; nothing personal until the form is submitted. */
(function () {
  var ENDPOINT = "https://myeventmatch.com/functions/trackEvent";
  var SITE = window.MEM_SITE || document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-site") || location.hostname.replace(/^www\./, "");
  var now = function () { return new Date().toISOString(); };
  var uuid = function () { return ([1e7]+-1e3+-4e3+-8e3+-1e11).replace(/[018]/g, function (c) { return (c ^ crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(1))[0] & 15 >> c / 4).toString(16); }); };
  var q = {}; location.search.replace(/^\?/, "").split("&").forEach(function (p) { if (!p) return; var kv = p.split("="); q[decodeURIComponent(kv[0])] = decodeURIComponent((kv[1] || "").replace(/\+/g, " ")); });
  var clickId = q.gclid ? ["gclid", q.gclid] : q.fbclid ? ["fbclid", q.fbclid] : q.ttclid ? ["ttclid", q.ttclid] : q.msclkid ? ["msclkid", q.msclkid] : null;
  // referrer classification when no UTMs
  function classify() {
    if (q.utm_source) return { source: q.utm_source, medium: q.utm_medium || "", campaign: q.utm_campaign || "", content: q.utm_content || "", term: q.utm_term || "" };
    if (clickId) { var m = { gclid: ["google","cpc"], fbclid: ["meta","paid_social"], ttclid: ["tiktok","paid_social"], msclkid: ["bing","cpc"] }[clickId[0]]; return { source: m[0], medium: m[1], campaign: "(clickid only)", content: "", term: "" }; }
    var r = document.referrer ? document.referrer.replace(/^https?:\/\//, "").split("/")[0] : "";
    if (!r || r.indexOf(location.hostname) > -1) return { source: "(direct)", medium: "(none)", campaign: "", content: "", term: "" };
    if (/google\./.test(r)) return { source: "google", medium: "organic", campaign: "", content: "", term: "" };
    if (/instagram|facebook|fb\.|tiktok|threads/.test(r)) return { source: r.replace(/^l\./, ""), medium: "organic_social", campaign: "", content: "", term: "" };
    if (/chatgpt|openai/.test(r)) return { source: "chatgpt", medium: "referral", campaign: "", content: "", term: "" };
    return { source: r, medium: "referral", campaign: "", content: "", term: "" };
  }
  // visitor (first touch, 365 days)
  var v = null; try { v = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("mem_visitor") || "null"); } catch (e) {}
  if (!v) { var ft = classify(); v = { visitor_id: uuid(), first_seen_at: now(), first_site: SITE, first_landing_page: location.pathname, first_touch: ft, first_click: clickId }; try { localStorage.setItem("mem_visitor", JSON.stringify(v)); } catch (e) {} }
  // session (30 min idle)
  var s = null; try { s = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem("mem_session") || "null"); } catch (e) {}
  var stale = !s || (Date.now() - new Date(s.last_at).getTime() > 30 * 60 * 1000);
  if (stale) { var lt = classify(); s = { session_id: uuid(), started_at: now(), site: SITE, landing_page: location.pathname + location.search, referrer: document.referrer, last_touch: lt, click: clickId, device: /Mobi|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent) ? "mobile" : (/iPad|Tablet/i.test(navigator.userAgent) ? "tablet" : "desktop"), viewport_w: innerWidth, pages: 0 }; }
  s.last_at = now(); s.pages += 1; try { sessionStorage.setItem("mem_session", JSON.stringify(s)); } catch (e) {}
  window.memTrack = function (event, data) {
    var payload = Object.assign({ event: event, ts: now(), page: location.pathname, site: SITE, visitor: v, session: s }, data || {});
    try { if (navigator.sendBeacon) navigator.sendBeacon(ENDPOINT, new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload)], { type: "text/plain" })); else fetch(ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain" }, body: JSON.stringify(payload), keepalive: true }); } catch (e) {}
  };
  memTrack("page_view");
  var s50 = false, s90 = false; addEventListener("scroll", function () { var p = (scrollY + innerHeight) / document.body.scrollHeight; if (!s50 && p > 0.5) { s50 = true; memTrack("scroll_50"); } if (!s90 && p > 0.9) { s90 = true; memTrack("scroll_90"); } }, { passive: true });
  setTimeout(function () { memTrack("time_30"); }, 30000);
  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) { var el = e.target.closest("[data-track]"); if (!el) { var a = e.target.closest("a[href^='tel:']"); if (a) memTrack("call_click", { element: a.getAttribute("href") }); return; }
    var t = el.getAttribute("data-track"); if (t === "cta") memTrack("cta_click", { element: el.getAttribute("data-name") || el.textContent.trim().slice(0, 40) });
    if (t === "brief-step") memTrack(el.getAttribute("data-step") === "1" ? "brief_started" : "form_step", { step_name: "brief-" + el.getAttribute("data-step") });
    if (t === "apply-step") memTrack(el.getAttribute("data-step") === "1" ? "application_started" : "form_step", { step_name: "apply-" + el.getAttribute("data-step") }); });
  document.addEventListener("focusin", function (e) { var f = e.target.closest("[data-form]"); if (f && e.target.name && !e.target.__memf) { e.target.__memf = 1; memTrack("field_focus", { element: e.target.name, step_name: f.getAttribute("data-form") }); } });
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", function () { if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") memTrack("exit", { max_scroll: s90 ? 90 : s50 ? 50 : 0 }); });
  // expose attribution for the form: copy these into hidden fields on submit
  window.memAttribution = function () { return { visitor_id: v.visitor_id, session_id: s.session_id, first_touch: v.first_touch, first_click: v.first_click, last_touch: s.last_touch, click: s.click, site: SITE, landing_page: s.landing_page, device: s.device, time_on_site_s: Math.round((Date.now() - new Date(s.started_at).getTime()) / 1000) }; };
})();
</script>
